entities.name: Lucio Cabañas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucio Cabañas Barrientos was a Mexican social leader, schoolteacher, union leader, and guerrilla leader who founded the social and political movement Party of the Poor in 1967. Under his leadership, the party later became a guerrilla organization that was active in the Sierra Madre del Sur mountain range of Guerrero.
